audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty prose is correct at 8/10 but the supporting text is written for a male enemy and never names what actually makes the lane hard: Flawless Duet (E) at 850 range is her only lockdown and the entire kill pattern hangs on it.
audit.why: Irelia's threat is conditional. Bladesurge (Q) closes only 600 units and heals; Defiant Dance (W) is a charged strike with reduced physical damage taken; the stun is the single ability that converts a step-up into a kill. Difficulty is therefore a function of whether E is up.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stated as Flawless Duet uptime: E is 16s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5, and every forward step is scheduled against it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes and phases[5].why assert magnitudes with no source ("a third of a health bar", "chunks a third of his bar") and phases[5] also misgenders.
audit.why: Defect 6 in the catalogue: the kit gives no damage numbers, so a fraction-of-health claim is invented precision. The spike is real; the number is not.
audit.corrected: Spikes restated without invented magnitudes: Lost Chapter steadies mana, level 6 is the answer to her all-in, Luden's makes every step-up hurt.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions are never stated. Nothing on the page says Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes off a Marked target or a minion it kills, nothing says Dissonance's slow field lands on the spot she dashes to, and nothing says Vanguard's Edge forms a wall.
audit.why: Riot's text: Bladesurge refreshes on a Marked target or one that dies to it — that is the reset engine and it is denied by not letting her have the minion. Command: Dissonance (W, 7s flat, 225 radius) leaves a slowing field, which lands on her landing spot after Bladesurge and taxes the exit. Command: Shockwave (R, 110/95/80) pulls her off a target after she has committed. Vanguard's Edge (R, 125/105/85) is a projectile that becomes a slowing wall.
audit.corrected: Cooldown field, do's/don'ts and mid/late breakdowns now state the reset condition, the Dissonance-on-landing-spot answer, and the Shockwave-after-commit timing with real cooldowns.

audit.why: Win rate 50.23% over 1507 games, matching the brief's games field.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all — catalogue defect 3 — and was three lines of filler.
audit.why: It is the one field whose job is to hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Flawless Duet 16s/10s, Bladesurge 10s plus its refresh condition, and Vanguard's Edge 125s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization report names Zed — a different champion entirely — as the Zhonya's trigger, and tells you to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain'.
audit.why: Template leak plus misgendering. The anti-heal note is genuinely applicable (Bladesurge heals), so it stays but is grounded on the actual ability.
audit.corrected: Zhonya's keyed to Irelia's level 6; Grievous Wounds keyed to Bladesurge's heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Misgendering throughout the full layer: tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.wave, six phases[].why, all three dosFull/dontsFull titles and bodies, and three report entries call Irelia 'he/his/him'.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists irelia as female; the owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun is the enemy.
audit.corrected: All pronouns corrected in the proposed rewrites.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under an unrelated title, and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted the same way — catalogue defect 2.
audit.why: The title promises a Dissonance placement rule and a wave rule respectively; the bodies explained neither.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to answer their own titles.

Crash on her E cooldown, not on autopilot, and hold the ball on yourself the whole way in.
